verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own pages document a custom trademark extranet. It gives in-house managers and outside counsel immediate, paperless access to trademark data, documents and evidence, with docket management, search and reporting on portfolios and dispute matters. Fenwick Labs also references custom trademark extranets. However, the documented portal is limited to the trademark practice, and the pages never describe its security. The real-time budget dashboards are described as tools for the firm's own partners, associates and project managers, not as a client portal. Missing for 10: any documented security controls (authentication, encryption, access permissions), a firm-wide portal covering matters and documents beyond trademark, client-facing matter status and budget views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
